paragraphs.text: Dauthi is a creature type used for a species of insane Horror -like beings trapped in the Shadows of Rath .
Dauthi have only been printed in black .

The cards as they appeared in the Tempest block didn't have the subtype Dauthi. It was later realized that a non- human race should have its own subtype, which resulted in Dauthi Slayer in its Time Spiral/Timeshifted form. The other cards were updated in the Grand Creature Type Update .

Weatherlight 's Shadow Rider depicts a Dominarian Dauthi in its original form. However, in the Grand Creature Type Update it was changed to a zombie . This was partially rectified in the Oath of the Gatewatch update, when it returned to just being a Knight .
The type would return on Dauthi Voidwalker in Modern Horizons 2 .
The Dauthi originally lived on Dominaria , maybe with another outward appearance.

During the time of their planeshift , the Dauthi were at war with the Soltari . The Thalakos were entrapped in the conflict, despite their neutrality. All three races were caught in the maelstrom of energy that surrounded Rath , and trapped within the "Shadows," the extraplanar space between Rath and Dominaria. They were left in an incorporeal state, unable to communicate with people on either plane, yet able to see into both the Dominarian reality and that of Rath. This predicament led the Dauthi to lose their sanity; it's possible that the Dauthi were already a race close to madness, and their condition provided the last push.

Dauthi aren't content to turn their psychotic nature on each other; some of them can seize corporeal beings and drag them to the shadow side of reality where their compatriots are ready to tear them apart.

Most Dauthi have the keyword ability Shadow representing their incorporeal state while trapped between the realities of Dominaria and Rath. The one exception is Dauthi Trapper , which doesn't have Shadow, but has an ability to grant Shadow.
